necessary_context.content: D is a compact full-rank subset of R^n. At round t choose x_t in D and observe only l_t=c_t(x_t) in [-1,1]. For a fixed unknown mu, E[c_t(x)|H_t]=mu^T x for every x in D and every history. Noise l_t-mu^T x_t is a martingale difference; independently sampled linear loss vectors are not required.
necessary_context.name: Bandit model

necessary_context.content: b_1,...,b_n are linearly independent members of D; every x in D has x=sum_i a_i b_i with a_i in [-1,1]. For positive-definite A, ||v||_{2,A}=sqrt(v^T A v). The exact spanner is assumed available here; no approximate-spanner transfer is asserted.
necessary_context.name: Spanner and matrix norm

necessary_context.content: R_T=sum_{t=1}^T(mu^T x_t-min_{x in D}mu^T x). It is random through chosen actions; it is not the sum of realized noisy losses minus a realized comparator.
necessary_context.name: Pseudoregret

necessary_context.content: For even n>=2, D_n=(S^1)^(n/2), with each two-coordinate block having Euclidean norm one. Theorem 3 uses uniform mu in D_n/n, scalar costs in {-1,+1} with mean mu^T x, and prints E R_T>=n sqrt(T)/10 for every T>=1.
necessary_context.name: Product-circle normalization
